    st.ctx.length ≤ entBytesMax)) : msgOwn l dq st ∗ pbMsg raftpb.Message l [] ⊢ msgOwnZ sz l dq st

    MsgSt) : msgInC sz l (if P then DFrac.own 1 else DFrac.discard) st ⊢ msgPtsC l dqh (if P then

theorem msgOwnZ_of_structC [package_sem : Assumptions] (sz : Bool) (l : Loc) (v : raftpb.Message)
    (els : List Loc) (cs : List EntryC) (mm : MessageM) (ctx : List w8) (E : CoPset) (Hu :
    v.unknownFields' = slice.nil) (Hsn : v.Snapshot' = null) (Hsz : sz = true → mm.Type' ≠ MsgSnap →
    ctx.length ≤ entBytesMax ∧ (∀ (e : EntryC), e ∈ cs → entBytes e ≤ entBytesMax) ∧ (List.map (fun
    e => entBytes e + 64) cs).sum ≤ 2 ^ 36) : typedPointsto l v (DFrac.own 1) ∗ cellRO v.Type'
    mm.Type' ∗ cellRO v.To' mm.To' ∗ cellRO v.From' mm.From' ∗ cellRO v.Term' mm.Term' ∗ cellRO
    v.LogTerm' mm.LogTerm' ∗ cellRO v.Index' mm.Index' ∗ cellRO v.Commit' mm.Commit' ∗ cellRO
    v.Vote' mm.Vote' ∗ cellRO v.Reject' mm.Reject' ∗ cellRO v.RejectHint' mm.RejectHint' ∗ ownSlice
    v.Entries' els DFrac.discard ∗ ([∗list] p;e ∈ els;cs, entRoC p e) ∗ ownSlice v.Context' ctx
    DFrac.discard ∗ ownSlice v.Responses' [] (DFrac.own 1) ⊢ |={E}=> msgOwnZ sz l (DFrac.own 1) {
    msg := mm, ents := List.map EntryC.model cs, snap := none, ctx := ctx, resps := [] }

    P then dqh else DFrac.discard) • if P then dqh else DFrac.discard

theorem msgSizeOk_of_lit (c : MsgC) (hu : c.f.uf = []) (he : c.model.ents = []) (hs : c.model.snap =
    none) (hr : c.model.resps = []) (hc : c.model.ctx.length ≤ entBytesMax) : msgSizeOk c

def movesB (t : w32) : Bool :=
  decide (t = MsgProp ∨ t = MsgApp ∨ t = MsgHeartbeat ∨ t = MsgReadIndex ∨ t = MsgTransferLeader)

theorem msgIn_toC [package_sem : Assumptions] {t : w32} {b : Bool} (hm : movesB t = false) (l : Loc)
    (dqe : DFrac) (st : MsgSt) : msgIn l dqe st ⊢ msgInC (b && movesB t) l dqe st

theorem flag_moves {sz : Bool} {t : w32} (ht : movesB t = true) : (sz && movesB t) = sz

theorem msgInC_nn [package_sem : Assumptions] (sz : Bool) (l : Loc) (dqe : DFrac) (st : MsgSt) :
    msgInC sz l dqe st ⊢ ⌜l ≠ null⌝ ∗ msgInC sz l dqe st

theorem msgInC_pass [package_sem : Assumptions] {ml : Loc} {m : MessageM} {st : MsgSt} {sz sz' :
    Bool} (h : m.Type' ≠ MsgProp) (hm : movesB m.Type' = true) (hs : sz' = true → sz = true) :
    (msgPtsC ml dqh DFrac.discard false st -∗ msgInC sz ml DFrac.discard st) ∗ msgPtsC ml dqh
    DFrac.discard false st ⊢ msgInC (sz' && movesB m.Type') ml (if m.Type' = MsgProp then DFrac.own
    1 else DFrac.discard) st

    msgPtsCC l dq dqe cap c ⊢ ⌜l ≠ null⌝ ∗ msgPtsCC l dq dqe cap c

    msgInC sz l dqe st ⊢ msgInC sz l dqe st ∗ ⌜sz = true → st.msg.Type' ≠ MsgSnap → st.ctx.length ≤
    entBytesMax⌝

theorem msgPtsCC_acc_entries [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (dq dqe : DFrac) (cap : Bool) (c
    : MsgC) : msgPtsCC l dq dqe cap c ⊢ ∃ es els, ⌜l ≠ null⌝ ∗ typedPointsto (structFieldRef
    raftpb.Message go!"Entries" l) es dq ∗ ownSlice es els dqe ∗ ([∗list] p;e ∈ els;c.f.entries,
    entRoC p e) ∗ (if cap = true then ownSliceCap Loc es (DFrac.own 1) else emp) ∗ ∀ els' ents'
    cap', typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Message go!"Entries" l) es dq -∗ ownSlice es els' dqe
    -∗ ([∗list] p;e ∈ els';ents', entRoC p e) -∗ (if cap' = true then ownSliceCap Loc es (DFrac.own
    1) else emp) -∗ msgPtsCC l dq dqe cap' (MsgC.mk (have __src := c.f; { type := __src.type, to :=
    __src.to, frm := __src.frm, term := __src.term, logTerm := __src.logTerm, index := __src.index,
    entries := ents', commit := __src.commit, vote := __src.vote, snapshot := __src.snapshot, reject
    := __src.reject, rejectHint := __src.rejectHint, context := __src.context, uf := __src.uf })
    c.resps)

theorem movesB_MsgApp : movesB MsgApp = true

def msgSzOk (sz : Bool) (c : MsgC) : Prop :=
  c.sentOk ∧ (sz = true → c.model.msg.Type' ≠ MsgSnap → msgSizeOk c)

theorem msgInC_msgIn [package_sem : Assumptions] (sz : Bool) (l : Loc) (dqe : DFrac) (st : MsgSt) :
    msgInC sz l dqe st ⊢ msgIn l dqe st

def msgOwnZ (sz : Bool) (l : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (st : MsgSt) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ c, msgPtsCC l dq DFrac.discard false c ∗ ⌜c.model = st ∧ msgSzOk sz c⌝)

theorem msgInC_of_struct [package_sem : Assumptions] (sz : Bool) (l : Loc) (v : raftpb.Message) (dqe
    : DFrac) (els : List Loc) (ms : MsgSt) (E : CoPset) (Hu : v.unknownFields' = slice.nil) (Hsn :
    v.Snapshot' = null) (hs : ms.snap = none) (hr : ms.resps = []) (hcap : needsCap ms.msg = false)
    (Hsz : sz = true → ms.ctx.length ≤ entBytesMax ∧ ms.ents.length * (entBytesMax + 64) ≤ 2 ^ 36) :
    typedPointsto l v (DFrac.own 1) ∗ cellRO v.Type' ms.msg.Type' ∗ cellRO v.To' ms.msg.To' ∗ cellRO
    v.From' ms.msg.From' ∗ cellRO v.Term' ms.msg.Term' ∗ cellRO v.LogTerm' ms.msg.LogTerm' ∗ cellRO
    v.Index' ms.msg.Index' ∗ cellRO v.Commit' ms.msg.Commit' ∗ cellRO v.Vote' ms.msg.Vote' ∗ cellRO
    v.Reject' ms.msg.Reject' ∗ cellRO v.RejectHint' ms.msg.RejectHint' ∗ ownSlice v.Entries' els dqe
    ∗ ([∗list] p;e ∈ els;ms.ents, entRZ sz p e) ∗ ownSlice v.Context' ms.ctx DFrac.discard ∗
    ownSlice v.Responses' [] (DFrac.own 1) ⊢ |={E}=> msgInC sz l dqe ms

    Loc) (dqe : DFrac) (st : MsgSt) : msgInC (sz && movesB t) l dqe st ⊢ msgInC sz l dqe st

theorem msgIn_prop [package_sem : Assumptions] {ml : Loc} {m : MessageM} {st : MsgSt} {sz : Bool} (h
    : m.Type' = MsgProp) : msgInC sz ml (DFrac.own 1) st ⊢ msgInC (sz && movesB m.Type') ml (if
    m.Type' = MsgProp then DFrac.own 1 else DFrac.discard) st

theorem msgInC_store_To [package_sem : Assumptions] (sz : Bool) (l : Loc) (dqe : DFrac) (st : MsgSt)

    raftpb.Message go!"To" l) p (DFrac.own 1) ∗ ∀ p' v, typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Message

                  ents := st.ents, snap := st.snap, ctx := st.ctx, resps := st.resps }

theorem msgInC_flag [package_sem : Assumptions] (sz sz' : Bool) (h : sz' = true → sz = true) (l :
    Loc) (dqe : DFrac) (st : MsgSt) : msgInC sz l dqe st ⊢ msgInC sz' l dqe st

theorem msgOwnZ_halves (sz : Bool) (l : Loc) (st : MsgSt) : msgOwnZ sz l (DFrac.own 1) st ⊢ msgOwnZ
    sz l dqh st ∗ msgOwn l dqh st

def msgInC (sz : Bool) (l : Loc) (dqe : DFrac) (st : MsgSt) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ c,
      msgPtsCC l (DFrac.own 1) dqe (needsCap st.msg) c ∗
        ⌜c.model = st ∧ c.csUfNil ∧ (sz = true → st.msg.Type' ≠ MsgSnap → msgSizeOk c)⌝)

theorem msgPtsCC_persist_els [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (dq dqe : DFrac) (cap : Bool) (c
    : MsgC) : msgPtsCC l dq dqe cap c ⊢ |==> msgPtsCC l dq DFrac.discard cap c

theorem msgInC_freeze [package_sem : Assumptions] (sz : Bool) (l : Loc) (dqe : DFrac) (st : MsgSt)
    (hty : st.msg.Type' ≠ MsgSnap) : msgInC sz l dqe st ⊢ |==> msgOwnZ sz l DFrac.discard st
